Mamdani Unveils Anti-Hate Plan, Accidentally Uses His Other Face

by J.K. Around
October 7, 2026
in Entertainment, Politics, U.S. News
4
0
VIEWS
Share on FacebookShare on Twitter

NEW YORK — Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s anti-hate announcement collapsed Tuesday when his head rotated mid-speech and his second face congratulated the anti-Israel activists collecting city checks, sources have confirmed.

GetLocal Permits

“We stand firmly against hate,” said Face One.

“Your funding cleared,” whispered Face Two.

An aide attempted to stop the rotation with a neck brace purchased through the Department of Maintaining Appearances, but both faces submitted separate requests for reimbursement.

Officials insisted there was no contradiction.

“The mayor condemns hate with his public-facing mouth,” explained a spokesperson.

GetLocal Permits

“His accounts-payable mouth handles community partnerships.”

The ceremony deteriorated when Mamdani cut a ribbon marked “STOP ANTISEMITISM,” then handed the scissors to activists requesting funds to shred it.

“This is what accountability looks like,” announced a consultant, standing directly in front of what accountability looked like.

One taxpayer asked whether the city would next fight arson by buying matches.

“Only for historically underfunded fire starters,” replied Face Two.

Reporters eventually discovered both faces shared one brain, which had been placed on administrative leave for asking where the money went.

City Hall blamed the confusion on Republicans, faulty lighting, and the offensive assumption that words should correspond with actions.

As of press time, Mamdani had promised to get to the bottom of the scandal, but neither face would identify which one was currently talking out of his ass.
